buy.title: Tickets
buy.note: You pay on Stripe's secure payment page. Afterwards you get a ticket link by email: everyone in your group opens it on their own phone.

errors.discount-not-valid-yet: This discount code can't be used yet.
errors.discount-not-for-product: This discount code isn't valid for this walk.
errors.discount-used-up: This discount code has been used up.
errors.payments-unavailable: Payments are temporarily unavailable. Nothing was charged. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.invalid-ticket: This ticket link isn't valid. Check that you copied the whole link from the email.
errors.ticket-revoked: This ticket is no longer valid (it was refunded or withdrawn).
errors.ticket-full: This ticket is already open on as many phones as it has persons.
errors.offline: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.ticket-used: This ticket has already been used to create a game.

success.title: Thank you!
